title: Monastery Firewine
summary: Provides 1 Camp Supply or can be drunk or thrown.

fields.Camp supplies: Provides 1 Camp Supply for a Long Rest.
fields.Drink: Bonus Action. Alcohol imposes disadvantage on Dexterity and Charisma checks for 2 turns.
fields.Throw: Action. Creates a permanent Alcohol surface in a 13 ft radius. Fire ignites it for 2 turns before it becomes Ash. Cold freezes it for 2 turns before it becomes Water.

changes: Added native BG3 rules using pinned item and linked gameplay sources. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
